entries.en: He tied an apron over his school uniform.
entries.zh: 他在校服外系上了围裙。

entries.en: The pharmacy occupies the corner opposite the library.
entries.zh: 药房位于图书馆对面的街角。

entries.en: The club's inaugural concert attracted a large audience.
entries.zh: 俱乐部的首场音乐会吸引了大批观众。

entries.en: The exhibit offers a sensory experience of life underwater.
entries.zh: 这个展览让人从感官上体验水下生活。

entries.en: The diagram compares light waves of different wavelengths.
entries.zh: 图解比较了不同波长的光波。

entries.en: Our local gardening guru answered questions about compost.
entries.zh: 本地的园艺行家回答了有关堆肥的问题。

entries.en: The lecture included an animation of cardiac activity.
entries.zh: 讲座中有一段展示心脏活动的动画。

entries.en: A red flag fluttered at the top of the mast.
entries.zh: 一面红旗在桅杆顶端飘扬。

entries.en: The kitten rested one paw on my notebook.
entries.zh: 小猫把一只爪子搭在我的笔记本上。

entries.en: The waterfall thundered beyond the last bend.
entries.zh: 最后一个弯道那头传来瀑布的轰鸣。

entries.en: Dry leaves whirled around the empty courtyard.
entries.zh: 干树叶在空旷的庭院里旋转。

entries.en: The characters flirt awkwardly during the comedy's opening scene.
entries.zh: 喜剧开场时，角色们笨拙地调情。

entries.en: The curtain fluttered against the open window.
entries.zh: 窗帘在敞开的窗边飘动。

entries.en: Before the match began, he bragged that he would win.
entries.zh: 比赛还没开始，他就吹嘘自己会赢。

entries.en: The class discussed a hypothetical town with no cars.
entries.zh: 全班讨论了一个假设中没有汽车的城镇。

entries.en: A dull thump came from the room upstairs.
entries.zh: 楼上的房间传来一声沉闷的撞击。

entries.en: The fans screamed in ecstasy at the final goal.
entries.zh: 最后一球进网时，球迷们狂喜地尖叫。

entries.en: The carpenter measured the doorway before cutting the frame.
entries.zh: 木匠先量了门口，再切割门框。

entries.en: The game gives each player a finite supply of tiles.
entries.zh: 游戏给每位玩家有限数量的牌。

entries.en: The course examines several novels in the literary canon.
entries.zh: 这门课研究文学经典中的几部小说。

entries.en: I bought a small ceramic boat as a souvenir.
entries.zh: 我买了一只小陶船作纪念品。
